_comment: Which product category each product example belongs to.
The 44 example pages each hold one photograph of a real Dietz part,
correctly attributed. The 12 category pages had none. This map is what
lets link-product-examples.py put the right photographs on the right
category page — and it is authored rather than inferred because getting it
wrong means telling a buyer that a plastic gear is a compression spring.
Every row below is justified by the example page's own h1 naming the part
type outright (Sonderdruckfeder, Zugfeder, Wellenring, Zahnrad aus
Polyoxymethylen), or by its photograph having been looked at directly.
Anything that needed a guess is in `_unclassified` instead, not here.
Ids are locale-independent: the DE and EN versions of an example share one
canonical id, so a single row serves both languages.
Real parts whose category cannot be settled from the page itself.
Left unplaced deliberately — an unillustrated category page is a gap; a
category page illustrated with the wrong part is a false claim about what
Dietz manufactures. Raised with the client for one pass of confirmation;
moving a row up into the map above is then the whole change.
_unclassified.example.produkte-anpressfeder: Named a spring, but its own caption describes a progressive-die concept, which points at a stamped part. Compression spring or stamped part?
_unclassified.example.produkte-rollofeder: The photograph is a flat formed strip clip, not a coiled spring. Likely Bandbiegeteile — which currently has no photograph at all — but 'feder' in the name argues otherwise.
_unclassified.example.produkte-schweissringe: Welding rings. Could be wire-bent or stamped.
_unclassified.example.produkte-sicherungshalter: Fuse holder. Stamped part or hybrid assembly?
_unclassified.example.produkte-spulenkoerper: Bobbin. Usually moulded plastic, but not stated on the page.
_unclassified.example.produkte-sitzwannenverstaerkung-: Seat-pan reinforcement / lumbar support. Wire-bent or strip?
_unclassified.example.produkte-zahnradachse: Gear axle. Turned, stamped, or part of an assembly?
_unclassified.example.produkte-montageteil-maschinenba: Assembly part. The Produkte hub uses its photo for Prototypen und Musterbau, which suggests prototyping rather than hybrid assemblies.
